decisions.decision: Wells policy (about $200 quarterly charge for 9 well users) deferred; the Commission will discuss it again at a future meeting.
decisions.quote: the commission will discuss the policy again at a future meeting.

decisions.decision: Easements to sewer allowed only case-by-case on a hardship basis, with an opinion to be sought from Town Counsel.
decisions.quote: the commission discussed and agreed it should be on a case-by-case hardship basis. they will also get an opinion from town counsel.

decisions.decision: Commission agreed to charge non-compliant grease trap establishments for inspections; Barb to run it by Town Counsel and Rob offered to do the inspections.
decisions.quote: the commission agreed to charge non-compliant establishments for inspections.

decisions.decision: Public hearings on the sewer policy changes to return to posting twice with only one hearing, to streamline the process.
decisions.quote: the commission discussed the change and agreed it will streamline the process.

decisions.decision: Commission will discuss its Annual Town Meeting warrant articles on 2/22.
decisions.quote: the commission will discuss their articles on 2/22.

decisions.decision: Barb directed to confirm whether the DEP requirement still applies to projects over 1,000 feet.
decisions.quote: barb will confirm if it is still required on projects over 1,000 feet.

decisions.decision: Dave asked Barb to take the grease trap inspection charge to Town Counsel.
decisions.quote: dave asked barb to run it by town counsel.

decisions.decision: Rob to seek more information on a performance bond requirement for drain layers for future discussion.
decisions.quote: rob said he will get more information for future discussion.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY23 draft sewer budget discussion was tabled and a budget meeting set for 2/15; no dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: fy23 draft sewer budget- dave suggested tabling the discussion and have a special meeting on 2/15 to discuss

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rob reported on American Rescue Plan Act money: a percentage of funds for general use, possibly easier to use, with projects prioritized; no dollar amount is printed.
budget_items.quote: originally, he thought the money would be just for wastewater projects, but actually the town will be getting a certain percentage of money for general use.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The re-connection fee was reduced from $1,000 to $100, with staff having suggested $50 to $100 for administrative work and inspection.
budget_items.quote: rob stated they currently charge $1,000 to re-connect to an existing service

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Barb noted the minimum bill is $107; she will check the Water District's prorating policy.
Nine users on wells pay a set quarterly charge of about $200 each; options for charging by bedrooms, residents or square footage were discussed, and the policy was deferred.
budget_items.quote: there is a set quarterly charge of approximately $200 for each.

budget_items.topic: Grease trap non-compliance fees and inspections
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY23 budget is said to reflect non-compliance fees; the Commission agreed to charge non-compliant establishments for inspections.
budget_items.quote: barb said the fy23 budget reflects non-compliance fees.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Barb noted Fitchburg has drain layers give the City a deposit on account; the figure was cited as a comparison for a possible bond requirement.
budget_items.quote: she noted in fitchburg, drain layers give the city $5,000 on account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Staff proposed a letter giving A&D Crossroads 30 days to respond or face a $50 charge, then $25 per day; the Commission voted to begin the non-compliance process.
budget_items.quote: barb would like to start the non-compliance process by sending out a letter stating they have 30 days, or it will be $50. if they don't respond, it will be $25/day.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Flow Assessment committed to another lease year at the same price; no dollar figure is printed.
budget_items.quote: rob added flow assessment has committed to another lease year, at the same price.
